notes.title: Super update!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We didn't update for a while, for a very good reason: we did massive changes! We had to retest everything, but now we are very happy with the new version, so please try it out and let us know how you like it!

- New music based levels!
- New bonus levels: space invaders and old school pang revisited!
- New mad boss: the hive!
- Zoomed out camera for even more action!
- More enemies!
- Improved the story!
- 7 new achievements!
- Boss 1 is more interesting!
- Boss 4 is more disco!
- Boss 3 is more forgiving!
- New mini-boss: the land raider!
- Drill mini-boss: more fun!
- New shotgun Ultra!
- New enemies!
- 15 new levels!
- Bloom effect!
- New user interface!
- Difficulty will also change the amount of enemies in the level!
- Fixed darkness shader on Mac and Linux!
- Fixed weird resolutions look!
- A ton of bug fixes!

Merry christmas everyone!

notes.title: Massive Update Incoming for Dragon Bros!
notes.content:
It's been a while since our last update, we have been working hard to implement a lot of stuff. People have told us to improve certain things and gave us precious suggestions, so, we have done that :D (unfortunately we haven't done literally everything you've told us to do but we have covered a lot..).

- The camera has been zoomed out completely to allow the player to have more freedom on movement especially in co-op.
- The amount of enemies on screen has massively increased as a result of the camera fix.
- The shape of the levels now change depending on difficulty and single/co-op mode. This gives a different challenge to the players and it's suitable for either casual or hardcore players.
- New levels and new mechanics!

This Update will be available shortly, right before Xmas.
We'll keep you updated!

We thank the community for all the support, for believing in us and for the precious feedback. Thanks a lot to the influencers and content creators such as Jim Sterling, Scythe Plays, Spicy Waffle, Neos Forme, The Killer Bits, AlChestBreach, etc..

notes.title: New patch 1.4 - two mini bonus levels, bug fixes, new HUD
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

A new patch just arrived, here is it what it contains:
- a new mini level, unlocked after you played the first level. It contains a tutorial to learn how to shoot diagonally.
- a new mini level, unlocked after you played the first level as well. It is a boss level where your character is equipped with infinite rockets. Try it on higher difficulties, it's really fun!
- new HUD showing up your ammo as a counter and showing whether you switched your secondary weapon on or off,
- no more recoil when you lock yourself in position with left trigger,
- supply crates are now explodable, making it more consistent,
- fixed the first boss head not respawning,
- fixed first level last arena red wheels not animating properly,
- fixed crash on keyboard rebinding page,
- fixed some animation for the machine gun.

Enjoy!

notes.title: New Patch 1.3b - gameplay changes, optimisation, minor bug fixes
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

And here comes a new patch! Here is the change list:

- pistol will automatically fire if you keep the shooting button pressed. The rate is lower in autofire mode than if you smash the buttons,
- you can switch weapon to use the pistol again and save your precious ammo for later. Just press LS. More UI and rebinding to come,
- vibration on the pad when you take damage (OSX and Windows only)
- optimized animation a lot by forcing a lot to cull when out of camera. CPU players should see a massive increase (from 60fps to 100fps in some bits),
- the game no longer reset the level you are in when you change the resolution,
- OSX: next tab and prev tab were inverted, fixed it,
- some sfx converted to ogg for compression,
- fixed some reverb being a bit screechy in level 1 and level 7,
- waterfall can be heard once again,
- added some sounds to the respawn animation.

Enjoy! And if anything is broken, please let us know asap.

notes.title: New patch 1.2 - bug fixes
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Here is a new patch with a few critical fixes. Among them:
- added a tutorial for the bulldozer enemies that can only be killed by stomping on them in the Library world level 2,
- fixed the drill boss in Cave 1 being buggy if you jump too often in the pit.
- change the ultra bar UI indication to press "Y" even if you are playing on keyboard.
- In windowed mode, the application does not mention DinoRampage, but Dragon Bros followed by the version number.
